entities.summary: Luis Antonio Bolín Bidwell was a Spanish lawyer, journalist and tour-operating expert. That led to his appointment as Head of the National Union of Catering and Allied Attorney in Parliament during the first four legislatures of Francoist Spain. In his memoirs, he simply uses the English spelling, Bolin.
